summary: No testing was done. I declined this request. From a code review of concurso.js and admin_routes.py, the app copies real public-exam organizers (Instituto AOCP, plus Cebraspe/FGV/Vunesp/IDCAP assets) and real exams (PMPE, CBMPE). It collects candidates' CPFs and charges fees by PIX to a personal Gmail key (danielmmm950@gmail.com) under the merchant name 'AOCP PE 2026'. That is a fake registration site for fraud and data theft, so I did not test, check or fix any part of it.
action_items: None. This work will not be supported.
